Set w=u2-u1; map (w,v,y1) to (y1w,(y1+1)w,v,y1,wv), with inverse projection to (u2-u1,v,y1), is an isomorphism A3=>X in all characteristics. Degree weights (+1,-1,0) preserve G_m action and quotient invariants K[y1,wv]. Thus A1=wK[y1,wv] is cyclic. Independently checked exact polynomial substitutions. This directly contradicts the quoted Section 5 noncyclicity assertion.
